sections.heading: Operator groups
sections.markdown:
### Arithmetic: `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `%`, `**` (power)
### Comparison: `==`, `!=`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`
### Logical: `&&`, `||`, `!`
### Bitwise: `&`, `|`, `^`, `~`, `<<`, `>>`
### Assignment: `=`, `+=`, `-=`, `*=`, `/=`, `%=`
### Increment/Decrement: `i++`, `i--` (variables only, not fields)
### Range: `a..b` (half-open), `a..=b` (inclusive)
### Null coalescing: `x ?? default`
### Optional chaining: `obj?.field`
### Spread: `...arr`
### Type: `typeOf(x)`, `x is Type`

sections.heading: Admitted XIR floating semantics
sections.markdown: The admitted new-XIR floating subset supports +, -, *, / and their compound assignments for f32/f64 (spec section 17.27). Each operation rounds once at its operand width, nearest with ties to even, including gradual underflow. Mixed f32/f64 widens before the operation; typed integer/float mixing, floating remainder and bitwise operations reject. Compound assignment reads the left value before evaluating the right, including suspension, and cannot narrow implicitly.
